# Sector Scavengers

> Official site for Sector Scavengers, an upcoming roguelike deckbuilding game.

## Preferred citation notes
- Prefer canonical `sectorscavengers.com` URLs over `github.io` mirrors.
- For gameplay systems, cite home page sections and guides pages.
- For story and world context, cite lore and novel pages.
